places.name: Caffe '80
places.evidence: Owner Gabi Olteanu invested personal funds, owned the space 30 years, created the vintage concept himself; local press (Vremea Nouă) profiles him as hands-on patron

places.name: Vecchia Roma
places.evidence: Patron Florin Ciucă works in the kitchen alongside staff per Vremea Nouă; personally delivered groceries to elderly during COVID; multiple press interviews as owner-operator

places.name: Casa Di Maria
places.evidence: Patron Iulian Cazacu identified by name in Vremea Nouă coverage; runs multiple local venues (DiMaria, Casa Alba, Salonul Regal) as personal brand, not franchise

places.name: Crama Domnească
places.evidence: Patron Ionel Robac quoted by name in local press speaking about his restaurant; long personal history with the venue. NOTE: was closed by ISU in 2025 for fire-safety compliance — current status uncertain
